spanish: Y verá el sacerdote, y he aquí su apariencia baja desde la piel, y su pelo se volvió blanco, y lo impurecerá el sacerdote; plaga de tsaráat ella; en la úlcera brotó.

findings.issue: צָרַעַת is a common noun, not a locked proper name; "tsaráat" leaves the lemma untranslated.
שָׁפָל is an adjective and מִן is only a preposition; "baja desde" can be read as motion away from the skin rather than a low appearance relative to the skin.
Qal הָפַךְ is "turned"; "se volvió" adds a pronominal middle. Same subject, the hair.
פָּרָחָה is 3fs and שְׁחִין is masculine, so the boil is not the subject; "brotó" cannot show that, and feminine "úlcera" can be taken as the subject.

notes: Sequential perfects as future, plain perfects as past, 3fs suffixes as su, and the 3ms object as lo match the morphology.
